    • build

      public FireworkEffect build()
      Create a FireworkEffect from the current contents of this builder. 根据此构建器的当前内容创建 FireworkEffect。

      To successfully build, you must have specified at least one color. 要成功构建，必须至少指定一种颜色。

      返回:
      The representative firework effect 对应的烟花效果
